title: Rethoughted Spawn Eggs X Bare Bones
description: A resource pack that makes Rethoughted Spawn Eggs have the Bare Bones unique style.
body:
![Sniffer and Magma Cube Spawn eggs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8e5cd9a11cc46ad3f6857a8a06fd56004e4e2ce2_0.webp)
## Changes
Makes [Rethoughted Spawn Eggs](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/rethoughted-spawn-eggs) resource pack compatible with [Bare Bones](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/bare-bones) style.
